g.title: One Zustand store holds mail per mailbox, filters, the open thread and the composer. Only the user and sign-in flag are persisted. useEmails loads 30 messages at a time, a 30 second timer refetches the current view, and filtering and sorting run client side.
The access token that GmailService attaches to every call. It was stored at sign-in, and closing the tab drops it.

Calls the Gmail REST API directly with the stored access token. Messages are fetched in parallel with Promise.allSettled, so one failed message is skipped. MIME parts are parsed into a typed model and HTML bodies are sanitised with DOMPurify before rendering.
Called from the browser with the gmail.modify scope and the user's own access token. No server holds the mail.
